parameters.query:
-- App-delete slot release (2026-08-27) by the bot's line (T5): synchronously with the app's delete action every row of
-- the line is retired as app_delete — the ONLY slot release for status='active' owners (the sweep never touches them)
-- and the mark that keeps a deleted bot's rows from ever being adopted by a later Create (Clone Plan / Bind refuse
-- app_delete). Rows are matched by profile id only, never by app_user_id (it drifts between create and delete).
--   session: every row of the line this install owns; one retired earlier (a replaced predecessor, a trial or a
--            subscription that ended, an orphan of the pre-F1 re-pairing) becomes app_delete too, its retirement time
--            kept. The line's clones are booked in clone_retirements (bot_deleted) for the sweep's branch A — never one
--            a live row outside the line drives, never a protected id; a clone already booked keeps its booking.
--   legacy:  the named rows still alive only (the pre-T5 behaviour), nothing booked.
-- Always one row: retiredProfiles (rows changed now) and bookedClones (bookings added now). Deletion Settled? reads
-- retiredProfiles only: the bookings are made by this same statement, so they cannot fail apart from it; bookedClones
-- is not part of the webhook's answer.
-- Parameters, in order: gate mode, install id, JSON array of the profile ids, JSON array of the workflow ids.
with recursive lin_me as (    -- the bot's line (plan 2026-10-11 §1.6): who deletes
  select i.install_id as inst from installs i
  where $1 = 'session' and i.install_id = nullif($2, '') and i.revoked_at is null
), lin_ids as (
  select 'p'::text as kind, v from (select x #>> '{}' as v from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof($3::jsonb) = 'array' then $3::jsonb else '[]'::jsonb end) x where jsonb_typeof(x) = 'string') a
  union all
  select 'w'::text, v from (select x #>> '{}' as v from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof($4::jsonb) = 'array' then $4::jsonb else '[]'::jsonb end) x where jsonb_typeof(x) = 'string') b
), lin_named as (
  select kind, v as id from lin_ids where v not in ('', '-1', 'null', 'undefined')
), lin_rows (profile_id) as (
  select bp.profile_id from bot_profiles bp join lin_me on bp.owner_id = lin_me.inst
  where exists (select 1 from lin_named n where (n.kind = 'p' and n.id = bp.profile_id) or (n.kind = 'w' and n.id = bp.workflow_id))
  union
  select bp.profile_id from lin_rows r
  join bot_profiles cur on cur.profile_id = r.profile_id
  join bot_profiles bp on bp.owner_id = cur.owner_id
    and ((nullif(bp.bot_key, '') is not null and bp.bot_key = cur.bot_key)
      or bp.superseded_by = cur.profile_id or bp.profile_id = cur.superseded_by)
), lineage_profiles as (
  select id as profile_id from lin_named where kind = 'p'
  union
  select profile_id from lin_rows
), lineage_workflows as (
  select id as workflow_id from lin_named where kind = 'w' and id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{8,36}$' and id not in ('0DP79STI3pafXO9B', '2htWSV5IHO8E2CgB', '2islisFH7jjLoPQM', '3qax5J9u2qsT9Vao', '4VN3gsFaC2HUYmcc', '4wYitz5ek30SVNlT', '9PTyYcelRQI7bGDb', 'KoTuIlk4LMrlvnWI', 'SCLcpn6DMDG3Z4VN', 'TwWPW3gIyjZS3foR', 'Uz6HBBUpAiUqVysB', 'XuvOp7TxOImOAmlj', 'ZGYr6srzS3rSSXHp', 'ZTqpumOpL1rNDOp6', 'crAuthSession001', 'crHandoffDry0001', 'crHandoffNtfy001', 'crHandoffReq0001', 'crHandoffsApi001', 'crPriceSearch001', 'crTestDialog0001', 'crWappiProxy0001', 'fXYpCXPKw92EzRz8', 'hHwvfOvTCS42pXnq', 'jtbssfzXbOxwTK4k', 'lmjYsdNcQA2IE5rl', 'olmqWMfcFpCEcpiE')
  union
  select bp.workflow_id from bot_profiles bp join lin_rows r on r.profile_id = bp.profile_id
  where bp.workflow_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{8,36}$' and bp.workflow_id not in ('0DP79STI3pafXO9B', '2htWSV5IHO8E2CgB', '2islisFH7jjLoPQM', '3qax5J9u2qsT9Vao', '4VN3gsFaC2HUYmcc', '4wYitz5ek30SVNlT', '9PTyYcelRQI7bGDb', 'KoTuIlk4LMrlvnWI', 'SCLcpn6DMDG3Z4VN', 'TwWPW3gIyjZS3foR', 'Uz6HBBUpAiUqVysB', 'XuvOp7TxOImOAmlj', 'ZGYr6srzS3rSSXHp', 'ZTqpumOpL1rNDOp6', 'crAuthSession001', 'crHandoffDry0001', 'crHandoffNtfy001', 'crHandoffReq0001', 'crHandoffsApi001', 'crPriceSearch001', 'crTestDialog0001', 'crWappiProxy0001', 'fXYpCXPKw92EzRz8', 'hHwvfOvTCS42pXnq', 'jtbssfzXbOxwTK4k', 'lmjYsdNcQA2IE5rl', 'olmqWMfcFpCEcpiE')
), line_clones as (     -- the line's clones that no live row outside the line drives
  select w.workflow_id from lineage_workflows w
  where not exists (select 1 from bot_profiles live where live.workflow_id = w.workflow_id and live.deleted_at is null
                      and live.profile_id not in (select profile_id from lineage_profiles))
), line_chunks as (     -- their chunks, one join per key: the RAG store's expression indexes (never a scan of the store)
  select d.id, d.metadata->>'fileId' as file_id from documents d join line_clones c on d.metadata->>'botWaId' = c.workflow_id
  union
  select d.id, d.metadata->>'fileId' from documents d join line_clones c on d.metadata->>'botTgId' = c.workflow_id
), retired as (
  update bot_profiles bp set deleted_at = coalesce(bp.deleted_at, now()), deleted_reason = 'app_delete'
  where bp.profile_id in (select profile_id from lineage_profiles)
    and ((exists (select 1 from lin_me) and bp.owner_id = (select inst from lin_me)
          and (bp.deleted_at is null or bp.deleted_reason is distinct from 'app_delete'))
      or (not exists (select 1 from lin_me) and bp.deleted_at is null))
  returning bp.profile_id
), booked as (
  insert into clone_retirements (workflow_id, profile_id, owner_id, reason)
  select c.workflow_id,
    (select bp.profile_id from bot_profiles bp join lin_rows r on r.profile_id = bp.profile_id
      where bp.workflow_id = c.workflow_id order by bp.created_at desc, bp.profile_id limit 1),
    (select inst from lin_me), 'bot_deleted'
  from line_clones c
  where exists (select 1 from lin_me)
    and exists (select 1 from bot_profiles bp join lin_rows r on r.profile_id = bp.profile_id where bp.workflow_id = c.workflow_id)
  on conflict (workflow_id) do nothing
  returning 1
)
select (select count(*)::int from retired) as "retiredProfiles", (select count(*)::int from booked) as "bookedClones";

-- Privacy deletion (2026-09-01, store audit / Data Safety «можно запросить удаление»), by the bot's line (T5):
-- a deleted bot's server-side conversation memory goes with it — under every profile of its line (session: this
-- install's rows of the same bot key, both channels, and the superseded chain; legacy: the named ids only). Chat
-- transcripts key off session_id = '<profileId>:<chatId>' (both bot templates' Chat Memory nodes); the history,
-- outcomes, handoffs, reply ledger, chat state and flags carry profile_id directly. Sentinels ('-1', '', 'null',
-- 'undefined') are no ids. dialog_counts stay UNTOUCHED on purpose: they are the owner's billing usage records
-- (Task 17a moves them with the money on transfer), not chat content.
-- Parameters, in order: gate mode, install id, JSON array of the profile ids, JSON array of the workflow ids.
with recursive lin_me as (    -- the bot's line (plan 2026-10-11 §1.6): who deletes
  select i.install_id as inst from installs i
  where $1 = 'session' and i.install_id = nullif($2, '') and i.revoked_at is null
), lin_ids as (
  select 'p'::text as kind, v from (select x #>> '{}' as v from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof($3::jsonb) = 'array' then $3::jsonb else '[]'::jsonb end) x where jsonb_typeof(x) = 'string') a
  union all
  select 'w'::text, v from (select x #>> '{}' as v from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof($4::jsonb) = 'array' then $4::jsonb else '[]'::jsonb end) x where jsonb_typeof(x) = 'string') b
), lin_named as (
  select kind, v as id from lin_ids where v not in ('', '-1', 'null', 'undefined')
), lin_rows (profile_id) as (
  select bp.profile_id from bot_profiles bp join lin_me on bp.owner_id = lin_me.inst
  where exists (select 1 from lin_named n where (n.kind = 'p' and n.id = bp.profile_id) or (n.kind = 'w' and n.id = bp.workflow_id))
  union
  select bp.profile_id from lin_rows r
  join bot_profiles cur on cur.profile_id = r.profile_id
  join bot_profiles bp on bp.owner_id = cur.owner_id
    and ((nullif(bp.bot_key, '') is not null and bp.bot_key = cur.bot_key)
      or bp.superseded_by = cur.profile_id or bp.profile_id = cur.superseded_by)
), lineage_profiles as (
  select id as profile_id from lin_named where kind = 'p'
  union
  select profile_id from lin_rows
), lineage_workflows as (
  select id as workflow_id from lin_named where kind = 'w' and id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{8,36}$' and id not in ('0DP79STI3pafXO9B', '2htWSV5IHO8E2CgB', '2islisFH7jjLoPQM', '3qax5J9u2qsT9Vao', '4VN3gsFaC2HUYmcc', '4wYitz5ek30SVNlT', '9PTyYcelRQI7bGDb', 'KoTuIlk4LMrlvnWI', 'SCLcpn6DMDG3Z4VN', 'TwWPW3gIyjZS3foR', 'Uz6HBBUpAiUqVysB', 'XuvOp7TxOImOAmlj', 'ZGYr6srzS3rSSXHp', 'ZTqpumOpL1rNDOp6', 'crAuthSession001', 'crHandoffDry0001', 'crHandoffNtfy001', 'crHandoffReq0001', 'crHandoffsApi001', 'crPriceSearch001', 'crTestDialog0001', 'crWappiProxy0001', 'fXYpCXPKw92EzRz8', 'hHwvfOvTCS42pXnq', 'jtbssfzXbOxwTK4k', 'lmjYsdNcQA2IE5rl', 'olmqWMfcFpCEcpiE')
  union
  select bp.workflow_id from bot_profiles bp join lin_rows r on r.profile_id = bp.profile_id
  where bp.workflow_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{8,36}$' and bp.workflow_id not in ('0DP79STI3pafXO9B', '2htWSV5IHO8E2CgB', '2islisFH7jjLoPQM', '3qax5J9u2qsT9Vao', '4VN3gsFaC2HUYmcc', '4wYitz5ek30SVNlT', '9PTyYcelRQI7bGDb', 'KoTuIlk4LMrlvnWI', 'SCLcpn6DMDG3Z4VN', 'TwWPW3gIyjZS3foR', 'Uz6HBBUpAiUqVysB', 'XuvOp7TxOImOAmlj', 'ZGYr6srzS3rSSXHp', 'ZTqpumOpL1rNDOp6', 'crAuthSession001', 'crHandoffDry0001', 'crHandoffNtfy001', 'crHandoffReq0001', 'crHandoffsApi001', 'crPriceSearch001', 'crTestDialog0001', 'crWappiProxy0001', 'fXYpCXPKw92EzRz8', 'hHwvfOvTCS42pXnq', 'jtbssfzXbOxwTK4k', 'lmjYsdNcQA2IE5rl', 'olmqWMfcFpCEcpiE')
), valid AS (
  SELECT profile_id FROM lineage_profiles
), hist AS (
  DELETE FROM public.n8n_chat_histories h
  WHERE split_part(h.session_id, ':', 1) IN (SELECT profile_id FROM valid)
  RETURNING 1
), outcomes AS (
  DELETE FROM public.conversation_outcomes c
  WHERE c.profile_id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM valid)
  RETURNING 1
), flags AS (
  DELETE FROM public.reply_mode_flags f
  WHERE f.profile_id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM valid)
  RETURNING 1
), hist_events AS (   -- stage 4: the one history
  DELETE FROM public.chat_history_events e
  WHERE e.profile_id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM valid)
  RETURNING 1
), handoffs AS (      -- stage 4: the bot's requests (and their pending notices)
  DELETE FROM public.handoff_requests r
  WHERE r.profile_id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM valid)
  RETURNING 1
), events AS (        -- stage 3: the event ledger + per-chat state
  DELETE FROM public.reply_events r
  WHERE r.profile_id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM valid)
  RETURNING 1
), states AS (
  DELETE FROM public.chat_reply_state s
  WHERE s.profile_id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM valid)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM hist)        AS "deletedMemoryRows",
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM outcomes)    AS "deletedOutcomes",
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM flags)       AS "deletedReplyFlags",
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM hist_events) AS "deletedHistoryEvents",
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM handoffs)    AS "deletedHandoffs",
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM events)      AS "deletedReplyEvents",
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM states)      AS "deletedChatStates";

parameters.query:
-- V12: may this install delete these ids? Decided here, never from the token's lists (live rows only, up to 12 h
-- old). A session may delete when its install is not revoked and EVERY id the delete will use is a string that belongs
-- to a bot_profiles row whose owner is this install, retired or not (a workflow id: the row it is bound to). A row
-- without an owner (never claimed) is never proof; at least one real id must be named. A token-less legacy call keeps
-- the old behaviour while the compat window is open. Read-only. `reason` says why a refusal happened: owned_elsewhere
-- (another install owns one of the ids) or unproven. Parameters, in order: gate mode, install id, JSON array of the
-- profile ids, JSON array of the workflow ids.
with ids as (
  select 'p'::text as kind, v #>> '{}' as id, jsonb_typeof(v) as t from jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) v
  union all
  select 'w'::text, v #>> '{}', jsonb_typeof(v) from jsonb_array_elements($4::jsonb) v
), named as (
  select kind, id from ids where t = 'string' and id not in ('', '-1')
), verdict as (
  select case
    when $1 = 'legacy' then 'ok'
    when $1 is distinct from 'session' or coalesce($2, '') = '' then 'unproven'
    when not exists (select 1 from installs i where i.install_id = $2 and i.revoked_at is null) then 'unproven'
    when exists (select 1 from ids where t <> 'string') then 'unproven'
    when not exists (select 1 from named) then 'unproven'
    when not exists (select 1 from named n where not exists (
           select 1 from bot_profiles bp where bp.owner_id = $2
              and ((n.kind = 'p' and bp.profile_id = n.id) or (n.kind = 'w' and bp.workflow_id = n.id)))) then 'ok'
    when exists (select 1 from named n join bot_profiles bp
                   on (n.kind = 'p' and bp.profile_id = n.id) or (n.kind = 'w' and bp.workflow_id = n.id)
                 where bp.owner_id is not null and bp.owner_id <> $2) then 'owned_elsewhere'
    else 'unproven' end as v
)
select (v = 'ok') as allowed, case when v = 'ok' then null else v end as reason from verdict;

), line_clones as (     -- the line's clones that no live row outside the line drives
